So the claim about "type-checked at compile time" is accurate for the defined properties themselves—the values are validated—even though the keys aren't strictly constrained. This nuance doesn't really refute the claim; the library does provide compile-time type checking for the `.meta()` definitions as stated. So the claim holds up—zod-openapi does provide compile-time type checking for OpenAPI properties through module augmentation, and the evidence directly supports this.
